name: Kyoto
tagline: Three-Michelin-star kaiseki since 1912, and the 400-meter market Kyoto calls "its kitchen."

Kikunoi Honten.description: Traditional kaiseki since 1912, one of the temples of Japanese haute cuisine. Three Michelin stars.

Nishiki Market.description: The 400-meter market known as "Kyoto's kitchen," with more than a hundred street food stalls.

Shoraian.description: Tofu kaiseki with views of the Katsura River, in Arashiyama.

Honke Owariya.description: Kyoto's oldest restaurant, serving soba on the same grounds since 1465. It was once an official supplier to the Imperial Palace.

Gion Karyo.description: Contemporary kaiseki in a historic Gion building, with more than thirty years of history and a daily-changing menu.
